summary: Executed backend pytest regression and preview UI e2e for admin/studio/cart/checkout/inquiry. Most flows pass, but admin product create/edit path still fails with backend 500.

critical.issue: POST product returns 500. Backend log shows FastAPI ResponseValidationError: extra field `updated_at` is returned but forbidden by ProductResponse strict schema.

integration_issues.issue: Save action is blocked by backend 500 from /api/admin/products despite valid login/upload/area editor interactions.

action_items: Fix backend product response model mismatch: either exclude `updated_at` from returned payload or add it to ProductResponse schema consistently for create/edit/archive/reactivate paths.
After backend fix, rerun full admin CRUD matrix including archive/reactivate and stale-version conflict through frontend and backend tests.
Re-validate old-draft-after-product-change reset flow once admin product mutation endpoint is healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: `checked_values()` injects `updated_at`, but endpoints use response_model=ProductResponse inheriting strict extra-forbid behavior; this creates runtime 500 at serialization.
Auth hardening checks now pass in tests: bcrypt `$2b$`, credentialed CORS with explicit origins, invalid origin rejection, refresh rotation, copied-cookie logout revocation.
Frontend assistant flow now works end-to-end with exactly one real text request; apply updates layout, undo restores, and transcript persists after reload.
Guided consultation remained zero-AI in request audit (no assistant or image-preview calls during guided steps).

seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST guest/session/order/inquiry data and attempted TEST admin product records; test files now auto-clean TEST products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use updated backend tests: origin assertion now supports ingress rewrite alias; cookie-rotation checks handle domain/path duplicate cookie names; reactivation payload strips strict-schema extras; session-rate flakiness mitigated with seeded refresh token strategy in tests.
rca of the issue: Repro: login admin -> upload product photo -> submit /api/admin/products. Actual: HTTP 500. Backend trace: ResponseValidationError (extra_forbidden: `updated_at`) while serializing ProductResponse. Root cause: data layer adds updated_at via checked_values(), response schema forbids unknown fields due StrictModel inheritance. Mitigation: align response payload and schema (either include updated_at in model and all related responses, or remove it from returned object while keeping DB persistence field).
